caseData.headline: Likely: money from lenders or linked companies is arriving dressed up as customer payments

findings.plain: money from lenders or linked companies is arriving dressed up as customer payments
the borrower has debt it has not disclosed
the borrower is connected to undisclosed shell companies
the reported financial statements don't fit the evidence

signals.explanation: 'Canyon Specialty Finance LP' holds a lien on a related company ('Magnolia Inventory Holdings LLC': inventory and proceeds) that the borrower never disclosed
The borrower's own SEC filings (10-K debt footnote, 8-K Item 2.03) name 'Canyon Specialty Finance LP' as a lender, but that debt was never disclosed to Wells Fargo
$221,944 (14.5% of inflows) arrived as 'customer' cash from 'Magnolia Inventory Holdings LLC', an undisclosed company linked to the borrower
Debt reported to Wells Fargo omits 2 secured lender(s) found in public lien filings
'Magnolia Inventory Holdings LLC' looks like a shell: no operations, same address as borrower, formed 12 months ago, no LEI / not in GLEIF
'Magnolia Trade Services LLC' looks like a shell: no operations, same address as borrower, no LEI / not in GLEIF
Reported revenue is running 19% above what verified customer cash supports (2 quarters in a row)
Undisclosed related company 'Magnolia Inventory Holdings LLC' shares the borrower's officer and address
Undisclosed related company 'Magnolia Trade Services LLC' shares the borrower's officer and address and phone number
Covenant metric landed within 5% above the threshold two quarters running
Not enrolled in Setpoint PledgeCheck: whether this collateral is also pledged at other lenders can't be verified

explanations: payments from Magnolia Property Partners LLC are from a disclosed related party
